run_async_render_physics: run a Habitat-Sim simulator that overlaps physics stepping with async rendering using start_async_render_and_step_physics
retrieve_async_observations: retrieve sensor observations from an async render by calling get_sensor_observations_async_finish on the simulator
step_physics_without_render: step the simulator physics without async rendering by calling step_physics with a time delta
reconfigure_simulator_scene: reconfigure a Habitat-Sim simulator to a new scene using close with destroy=False then reconfigure to avoid GPU memory leaks
acquire_gl_context: acquire the OpenGL context back to the main thread by calling renderer.acquire_gl_context during async rendering
